posts.cooked:
Hello, Can someone please help with the below sed question?
You are given a log file where each line contains timestamped events
Write a sed script named error_logs.sed that extracts all lines where the event type is ERROR or CRITICAL_ERROR and formats the output to only show the timestamp and the error message in the following format:

##Sample Input:

2024-11-20 14:30:12, ERROR, disk_space_low, message=Disk space is below threshold
2024-11-20 14:31:15, WARN, cpu_usage_high, message=CPU usage is above limit
2024-11-20 14:33:05, CRITICAL_ERROR, memory_overflow, message=Memory overflow detected
2024-11-20 14:35:25, ERROR, network_timeout, message=Network request timed out

##Sample Output:

Timestamp: 2024-11-20 14:30:12, ErrorMessage: Disk space is below threshold
Timestamp: 2024-11-20 14:33:05, ErrorMessage: Memory overflow detected
Timestamp: 2024-11-20 14:35:25, ErrorMessage: Network Request timed out

Constraints

  • The script must be a sed script and not a bash script
  • Only include lines with ERROR or CRITICAL_ERROR events.
  • Format the output strictly as shown in the example

##Instructions

  • The sed script should be present in /se2001/
  • The script should be executable

This is what I am trying to do but I am getting an error:
Step1: Note I don’t have a logfile so I am creating one as follows:
nano logfile.txt
copy the below to the text file and hit ctrl+O enter ctrl+x (or ctrl+X y enter)
2024-11-20 14:30:12, ERROR, disk_space_low, message=Disk space is below threshold
2024-11-20 14:31:15, WARN, cpu_usage_high, message=CPU usage is above limit
2024-11-20 14:33:05, CRITICAL_ERROR, memory_overflow, message=Memory overflow detected
2024-11-20 14:35:25, ERROR, network_timeout, message=Network request timed out

Step 2: create the error_logs.sed file:
nano error_logs.sed
#!/bin/sed -f

Match lines containing ERROR or CRITICAL_ERROR

/ERROR|CRITICAL_ERROR/ {
# Extract the timestamp and message, then format the output
s/^([^,],[^,]), [^,], [^,], message=(.*)$/Timestamp: \1, ErrorMessage: \2/
}

save the script and then came back to teh terminal
Step 3: chmod +x error_logs.sed
Step 4: sed -f error_logs.sed logfile.txt
Output:
2024-11-20 14:30:12, ERROR, disk_space_low, message=Disk space is below threshold
2024-11-20 14:31:15, WARN, cpu_usage_high, message=CPU usage is above limit
2024-11-20 14:33:05, CRITICAL_ERROR, memory_overflow, message=Memory overflow detected
2024-11-20 14:35:25, ERROR, network_timeout, message=Network request timed out

Can someone please help

posts.cooked: Note that I have to create my own logfile.txt because I dont have one in the cwd
